speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: You've come, then.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I said Friday.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: You said it in a letter.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: You're thin. They don't feed players, then.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They feed a man when he pays. The road was herring and pottage. I am not making a story of it in the doorway.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: And who's this gentleman?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A bay, hired, and sour, as he was described. Richard has him. I am not asking the shop to admire a horse.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: By my troth, he has more legs than a glove. Have him off the step before he improves the threshold.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Father. Is that the sword? The one that has killed people who were not really killed?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is a lath. It comes out of the cloak and into thy hand. Four Richmonds, on a stage, and nowhere else.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: The hilt turned in the cloak. I want to see it. Judith, leave the knot. A sword is not a sharing.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: The knot is ribbons. I know a ribbon when it is not a sword. Give them here.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three colours. They are thine. The book is not.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: I did not ask for the book. Susanna is by the stair with her hands folded, which means the book is already hers.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Thank you, sir.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Open it if thou wilt. It is riddles, not a lesson I am setting.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: I have opened it. There is a page. I am not going to read the page aloud in a doorway.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The flour is on my arms because the bread is new. Come through. Thou art dripping on a floor I have just had left.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: Put the dry things above the wet. The wallet can wait in the kitchen. The cloak can wait away from the bread.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Four Richmonds is a London count. In this doorway a gentleman is a horse until he is a customer, and this one is not.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Does the lath bend? I shall not bend it where it can be seen, which is the rule, and I have said the rule, so the rule exists.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Three colours, and none of them grey. The cloak was the grey thing. I am finished with the knot.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: No quarrel out of a knot. The gifts are out. Will, the letter had the day in it. The house was ready because the day was written, not because thou art a surprise.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The day was Friday. I am in it. I have not got a speech to set on top of the day.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: Then do not set one. Be thin at the table, if thou must be thin, and not in the doorway.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: I am not twelve until May. I am only saying the book is welcome, sir. The first riddle looks like a key.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: The hilt is worn on purpose. That is the true part. The Richmonds can wait until there is a room for a rule.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: I have the ribbons, and I am not trading. Susanna has the book. He has the sword. The doorway is done with deciding.
